content: Where there is fierce courage in the breast, a pathway through the deepest snow will always be carved.
author: Celtic & Norse Proverbs
sourceWork: Viking Saga Lore & Icelandic Gnomic Wisdom
explanation: A snowdrift ten feet deep stops the fainthearted dead in their tracks. But when the chest burns with devotion to family, honor, and duty, the warrior lowers his shoulder, breaks the crust, and tramples a trail where no path existed before. Courage makes a road.
practicalInsight: Do not wait for clear paths or ideal conditions today. Forge your own trail through the resistance.
reflectionPrompt: What obstacle are you treating as an impassable snowdrift, simply because no one else has shoveled it for you?
